newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York added temporary reserves to the U.S. banking system on Wednesday through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The add move matched the expectations of Wall Street Fed watchers.
At 1030 EST/1530 GMT, when the central bank usually intervenes in the market, federal funds were quoted at 5-11/16, above the Fed's current target rate of 5.50 percent.
